en.name: Flipbook Animation
en.title: Flipbook Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A moodboard collapses into a book, flips page by page, then bursts into a 3D collage drifting toward the camera. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Prepare 15 cards of 240×320, each with a front, a back and a paper edge as thick as the page spacing, and place them in a 5×3 grid inside an app window at scale 0.76. On the click (1.62s) collapse them with expo.out over 1.15s into a closed book at screen center, scale 1.6, page spacing 3.6px, spine at x 960, while the window recedes to z −320 over 0.8s and the view pans 211px left to center the closed book.

Flip the pages from 2.6s to 4.78s: each page turns about the spine with power2.inOut, the gap between flips shrinks from 0.20s to 0.07s, and the last six pages stop in a fan between −168° and −58° so they are in the air together. Turn the camera from rotY −26° to +20° at constant speed under perspective 1600px, hold the fan for 0.17s, then shrink the cards to 0.93 times their book size over the last 0.1s while the camera backs to z 200.

At 4.95s send the 15 cards to z −330 to +340 and 8 shapes (4 discs, 2 rounded squares, a dotted ring and a thin outline ring) to z −420 to +380 with expo.out over about 1.3s, each card turning on to face-on, then drift the cards 40–170px toward the camera until 10.5s with depth-of-field blur up to about 4px. Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: What is a flipbook animation in a product video?

It turns a set of screens or images into pages of a book that flip one after another. In this film the cards from a moodboard become the pages, so the transition shows the same content before, during and after the flip.
How does the film go from a flat interface to a 3D collage?
All 15 cards are 3D elements from the first frame. At the click they leave the grid, form the book, flip and then fly to scattered depths between z −330 and +340, so no mask or cross-fade is needed.

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

zh.name: 翻页动画效果
zh.title: 翻页动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 白板里的卡片收成一本书，越翻越快，再炸开成朝镜头漂来的 3D 拼贴。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个翻页动画效果。
howto: 准备 15 张 240×320 的卡片，每张有正反面和一条与页间距等厚的纸边，按 5×3 放进 App 窗口，缩放 0.76。点击时（1.62s）用 expo.out 1.15s 把它们收成屏幕中央合上的一本书，缩放 1.6，页间距 3.6px，书脊在 x 960，窗口同时用 0.8s 退到 z −320，画面向左平移 211px 让合上的书居中。
2.6s 到 4.78s 翻页：每页以书脊为轴转动，缓动 power2.inOut，页间隔从 0.20s 缩到 0.07s，最后 6 页停成 −168° 到 −58° 的扇形，所以它们同时在空中。透视 1600px 下相机 rotY 从 −26° 匀速转到 +20°，扇形停住 0.17s，最后 0.1s 书堆缩到 0.93 倍，相机退到 z 200。

4.95s 用 expo.out 把 15 张卡片炸到 z −330 到 +340，8 个形状（4 个圆、2 个圆角方块、1 个点线圆环、1 个细线圆环）炸到 z −420 到 +380，用时约 1.3s，每张卡片继续转到正面朝前，然后卡片在 10.5s 前朝镜头漂 40–170px，景深模糊最大约 4px。点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 产品视频里的翻页动画是什么？
把一组界面或图片做成书页，一页接一页翻过去。这支片子里白板的卡片就是书页，所以翻页前、翻页中和翻页后看到的是同一批内容。
片子怎么从平面界面变成 3D 拼贴？
15 张卡片从第一帧起就是 3D 元素。点击后它们离开网格，收成书，翻页，再飞到 z −330 到 +340 的不同深度，不需要遮罩或叠化。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
